package loadtest

import (
	"hash/fnv"

	"example.com/moba-practice/game/moba"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/lockstep"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
)

// BattleSink 将 Robot 输出交给已认证的可靠连接；会话绑定仍由业务接入层负责。
type BattleSink struct{ Send func(lockstep.Command) error }

func (s BattleSink) SubmitInput(frame lockstep.FrameID, data []byte) error {
	return s.Send(lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpInput, Frame: frame, Payload: data})
}
func (s BattleSink) RequestCatchup(frame lockstep.FrameID) error {
	return s.Send(lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpCatchup, Frame: frame})
}
func (s BattleSink) ReportHash(frame lockstep.FrameID, hash uint64) error {
	return s.Send(lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpHash, Frame: frame, Hash: hash})
}

// NewBattleBot 使用正式 Robot 拼帧、追帧与上报 hash。输入由调用方按服务端节拍发送，
// 不能在追历史帧时补发过期业务输入；所有调用须在同一个驱动 goroutine 中串行执行。
func NewBattleBot(player lockstep.PlayerID, sink BattleSink) (*robot.LockstepBot, *moba.State, error) {
	state := moba.NewState()
	bot, err := robot.NewLockstepBot(robot.LockstepBotConfig{Player: player, Sink: sink, Simulate: state.Apply, MaxBuffer: 128, Hash: func(lockstep.FrameID) uint64 {
		h := fnv.New64a()
		_, _ = h.Write([]byte(state.Digest()))
		return h.Sum64()
	}})
	return bot, state, err
}

// DuelInput 是可复现的双人场景输入，不读取服务端内部状态。
func DuelInput(frame lockstep.FrameID, seat int) []byte {
	if frame <= 5 {
		step := int8(1)
		if seat == 1 {
			step = -1
		}
		return moba.Encode(moba.Command{Action: moba.Move, Step: step})
	}
	action := moba.Attack
	if frame%4 == 0 {
		action = moba.Cast
	}
	return moba.Encode(moba.Command{Action: action, Target: moba.HeroTarget})
}

// SiegeInput 只读客户端自己应用的状态；服务端未向 Robot 暴露参考模拟。
func SiegeInput(state *moba.State, seat int) []byte {
	if seat != 0 {
		return moba.Encode(moba.Command{})
	}
	hero := state.Heroes[0]
	command := moba.Command{}
	switch {
	case hero.X < 7:
		command = moba.Command{Action: moba.Move, Step: 1}
	case state.Towers[1] > 0:
		command = moba.Command{Action: moba.Attack, Target: moba.TowerTarget}
	case hero.X < 9:
		command = moba.Command{Action: moba.Move, Step: 1}
	default:
		command = moba.Command{Action: moba.Attack, Target: moba.BaseTarget}
	}
	return moba.Encode(command)
}
